meta.notes: ERR crafting uses 24 base elements in four groups: Alchemics, Substances, Extracts, and Amalgams. Raw materials break down into those elements, and recipes spend the elements. This file has the 171 recipes and 24 breakdown tables parsed from the ERR wiki Crafting/Recipes page, revision 2026-10-12T04:13:31Z, CC BY-SA (Fandom). The wiki table is three columns wide, and the parse stores neighboring column headings in each path, so only the last path entry is the category shown here. Recipe effect text is not in that parse and is left out. Yields are the wiki quantities. Sources: https://err.fandom.com/wiki/Crafting and https://err.fandom.com/wiki/Crafting/Recipes .
